description: if you are tired of cheat clients or visuals, you can relax with this mod. This client mod is NOT made in modern style and contains 10+ functions. The mod is suitable for version 1.20.1 and is aimed at the Russian server HolyWorld. This is a VERY-PRE Beta test. In future, I plan to add at least 20 new features and adapt the mod for multiserver use.

mods.name: BQoL
mods.description: Better Quality of Life. The mod is in BETA TEST. SOON I will add work with the HolyWorld API (LITE API). There is currently no support and the mod may be BANNED on some servers

releases.notes:
- Added a bind for "Better Particles".
- Fixed a notification for "Better Particles".
- Added "Better Hurt Cam," which disables the camera when taking damage.
- Added "Better Third Person," which improves the third-person view.
- "Better Sprint" has been renamed to "Better Movement".
- Fixed "Better Mine" functionality.

- "Shulker Particles" has been renamed to "Better Particles", which includes Shulker and Totems modes.

- Added "Better RRLS", which removes the reloading Mojang splash screen.
- Added support for calculating the number of slots on the HolyWorld server for RCT.

- Fixed a bug with missing customization for some spheres.
- Removed unnecessary files.

A huge number of things have been added, so much so that I've almost forgotten what I needed to add. However, I'll summarize:

releases.notes:
- Added new function "Better TNT":
- Timer - timer over dynamite until it explodes.
- Alert - when there is dynamite set on fire nearby, a plaque with information appears.
- Alert Location - changeable location of the tile.
- Show XYZ - display of dynamite coordinates
- Added new feature "Better Holograms":
- Visible Stand - allows you to see Armor stands if they are hidden.
- Anti-Holograms - Cancels the rendering of all holograms.
- Added a second page of sounds to Better Sounds.
- Even more sounds have been added to Better Sounds.
- Now you can walk even with the GUI mod open.
- Fixed scrolling and added a scroll bar.
- Fixed a bug with the display of most spheres in Better Spheres
- Fixed a bug with disabling custom color in Better Sky
